nodes.name: ASTExtractor
nodes.docstring: Orchestrate AST extraction: file discovery → node building → edge building.

nodes.name: extract
nodes.docstring:
Extract AST structure from a codebase.

        Parameters
        ----------
        codebase_path : str
            Path to the root of the codebase to analyse.

        Returns
        -------
        ExtractionResult
            Files, nodes, edges, and any extraction errors.

        Raises
        ------
        FileNotFoundError
            If the codebase path does not exist.
        ValueError
            If the codebase path is not a directory.

nodes.name: EdgeBuilder
nodes.docstring: Detect relationships between AST nodes: calls, imports, extends.

nodes.name: build_edges
nodes.docstring:
Analyze parsed trees to find edges between known nodes.

        Parameters
        ----------
        nodes : list[ASTNode]
            All extracted AST nodes.
        trees : dict[str, tuple[tree, bytes]]
            Mapping of relative file path → (tree-sitter Tree, source bytes).

        Returns
        -------
        list[Edge]
            Edges referencing valid node_ids only.

nodes.name: _detect_calls
nodes.docstring: Detect function call relationships within a file.

nodes.name: _detect_extends
nodes.docstring: Detect class inheritance (extends) relationships.

nodes.name: _detect_imports
nodes.docstring: Detect import relationships between files.

nodes.name: _find_definition_node
nodes.docstring: Find the tree-sitter node corresponding to an ASTNode by name matching.

nodes.name: _search_for_definition
nodes.docstring: Recursively search for a function/class/method definition by name.

nodes.name: _is_matching_definition
nodes.docstring: Check if a tree-sitter node matches the expected definition.

nodes.name: _collect_call_names
nodes.docstring: Recursively collect all function/method call names in a subtree.

nodes.name: _extract_base_classes
nodes.docstring: Extract base class names from a class definition.

nodes.name: _collect_import_names
nodes.docstring: Collect imported names from import statements.

nodes.name: _walk_imports
nodes.docstring: Recursively find import statements and extract imported names.

nodes.name: _extract_ts_import_names
nodes.docstring: Extract imported names from TypeScript import clauses.

nodes.name: _find_child
nodes.docstring: Find the first child node with the given type.

nodes.name: FileDiscovery
nodes.docstring: Enumerate source files in a codebase, detect language, respect .gitignore.

nodes.name: discover
nodes.docstring:
Walk the directory tree and return FileInfo for each recognised source file.

        Respects .gitignore patterns found at the codebase root.
        Skips files whose extension is not in the known language map.
        Returns an empty list for empty directories.

nodes.name: _load_gitignore
nodes.docstring: Load .gitignore from root and combine with default ignore patterns.

nodes.name: NodeBuilder
nodes.docstring: Walk a tree-sitter AST and extract function, class, and method nodes.

nodes.name: build_nodes
nodes.docstring:
Extract function/class/method nodes from a parsed tree-sitter tree.

        Parameters
        ----------
        tree : tree_sitter.Tree
            The parsed tree-sitter tree.
        file_info : FileInfo
            Metadata about the source file (path, language).

        Returns
        -------
        list[ASTNode]
            Extracted nodes with all required attributes.

nodes.name: _walk
nodes.docstring: Recursively walk the AST and collect function/class/method definitions.

nodes.name: _handle_python_decorated
nodes.docstring: Handle a decorated_definition node (decorator + function/class).

nodes.name: _handle_python_class
nodes.docstring: Extract a class node and recurse into its body for methods.

nodes.name: _build_python_function
nodes.docstring: Build an ASTNode from a Python function_definition.

nodes.name: _extract_python_params
nodes.docstring: Extract parameter strings from a function_definition.

nodes.name: _extract_python_return_type
nodes.docstring: Extract return type annotation from a function_definition.

nodes.name: _extract_python_docstring
nodes.docstring:
Extract docstring from a function or class definition.

        The docstring is the first expression_statement containing a string
        in the body block. Falls back to raw source extraction when tree-sitter
        produces an ERROR node (e.g., for docstrings containing quote characters).

nodes.name: _extract_docstring_from_error
nodes.docstring:
Try to extract a docstring from an ERROR node using raw text.

        When tree-sitter can't parse a docstring (e.g., it contains quote
        characters), we fall back to scanning the raw text for triple-quoted
        strings.

nodes.name: _strip_string_quotes
nodes.docstring: Strip triple or single quotes from a string literal and normalise line endings.

nodes.name: _extract_decorator_text
nodes.docstring: Extract the decorator text without the @ symbol.

nodes.name: _walk_typescript
nodes.docstring: Walk TypeScript/JavaScript AST.

nodes.name: _extract_ts_jsdoc
nodes.docstring: Extract JSDoc comment preceding a node.

nodes.name: _walk_generic
nodes.docstring: Generic fallback for unsupported languages — look for common patterns.

nodes.name: _child_text
nodes.docstring: Get the text of the first child with the given type.

nodes.name: _find_child
nodes.docstring: Find the first child node with the given type.

nodes.name: _collect_nearby_comments
nodes.docstring:
Collect TODO/FIXME comments near a function/class definition.

        Checks the previous sibling and comments inside the body.
comments: # Check previous sibling for comments (e.g., # TODO above function)

Extract and parse JSON from LLM response text.

    Handles common LLM output patterns:
    - Raw JSON
    - JSON wrapped in markdown code fences (```json ... ```)
    - Leading/trailing text around JSON
    - Trailing commas (common LLM error)

nodes.name: PruningDecision
nodes.docstring: Record of a pruning decision.

nodes.name: PruningEngine
nodes.docstring:
Track high-confidence nodes and decide what to skip in subsequent batches.

    Requires edge information to determine downstream dependencies of pruned nodes.
    A downstream dependency is only pruned if ALL its incoming edges come from
    already-pruned nodes (i.e., it has no other pending references).

nodes.name: record_confidence
nodes.docstring:
Record a node's confidence from LLM output.

        If confidence is 'high', marks the node as pruned and also marks
        downstream dependencies for pruning (unless they have other pending
        references from non-pruned nodes).

nodes.name: _prune_downstream
nodes.docstring: Recursively prune downstream nodes that have no other pending refs.

nodes.name: should_prune
nodes.docstring: Check if a node should be skipped in the current batch.

nodes.name: get_pruned_nodes
nodes.docstring: Return set of node_ids currently pruned.

nodes.name: reinstate
nodes.docstring:
Re-include a previously pruned node.

        Returns True if the node was reinstated, False if it wasn't pruned.

nodes.name: get_decisions
nodes.docstring: Return all pruning decisions for narrative chain recording.

nodes.name: SourceSnippet
nodes.docstring: Extracted source code snippet for LLM review.

nodes.name: SourceReviewer
nodes.docstring: Extract original source code snippets for nodes needing review.

nodes.name: extract_snippet
nodes.docstring:
Extract function body or class definition from source file.

        Returns None if file not found or node cannot be located.
        Only extracts the specific node, not the entire file.

nodes.name: _find_definition
nodes.docstring:
Find the start and end line of a function/class definition.

        Returns (start_line, end_line) as 1-indexed inclusive, or (None, None).

nodes.name: _find_end_of_block
nodes.docstring:
Find the last line of a block starting at start_idx.

        A block ends when we encounter a non-empty line at the same or lower
        indentation level (excluding the start line itself).

nodes.name: render_l1_5

nodes.name: _escape_label
nodes.docstring: Escape Mermaid-unsafe characters in labels.

nodes.name: BatchAssigner
nodes.docstring: Assign batch numbers for topology-guided LLM reading.

nodes.name: assign_batches
nodes.docstring:
Assign batch numbers to all nodes.

        Rules:
        - Entry points -> batch 1 (always)
        - Remaining nodes sorted by descending in_degree -> distributed across batches 2..max_batches

        Returns dict mapping node_id -> batch_assignment.

nodes.name: EntryPointDetector
nodes.docstring: Detect whether an AST node is a framework entry point.

nodes.name: is_entry_point
nodes.docstring:
Return True if node is an entry point.

        Entry point rules:
        1. Has a known framework entry decorator, OR
        2. Has in_degree=0 AND out_degree>0 AND file path contains an entry directory

nodes.name: _has_entry_decorator
nodes.docstring: Check if any decorator matches known entry decorators.

nodes.name: _is_in_entry_directory
nodes.docstring: Check if the node's file is in a known entry directory.

nodes.name: GraphBuilder
nodes.docstring: Build a networkx directed graph from AST nodes and edges.

nodes.name: build
nodes.docstring:
Build a MultiDiGraph with all nodes and edges.

        All nodes are added even if they have no edges (isolated nodes).
        Uses MultiDiGraph to correctly count parallel/duplicate edges.

nodes.name: TopologyAnalyzer
nodes.docstring: Orchestrate topology analysis: graph -> degrees -> entry points -> batches -> ranks.

nodes.name: analyze
nodes.docstring:
Compute full topology analysis for all nodes.

        Must complete in < 1 second for up to 1000 nodes.

nodes.name: AnchorCheck
nodes.docstring: Verify that every feature references real AST nodes (no hallucinations).

nodes.name: check
nodes.docstring:
Check that all source_nodes reference existing node_ids.

        Also verifies every feature has at least one source_node.

nodes.name: CoverageCheck
nodes.docstring: Verify that LLM output covers all nodes from Structure JSON.

nodes.name: check
nodes.docstring:
Check that union of source_nodes + unclassified + infrastructure = all node_ids.

        Returns uncovered node_ids if incomplete.

nodes.name: LanguageCheck
nodes.docstring: Scan L1 feature labels and descriptions for prohibited technical terms.

nodes.name: check
nodes.docstring:
Scan all label and description fields for prohibited terms.

        Returns offending terms and their locations.

nodes.name: check_l1_5
nodes.docstring:
Scan L1.5 block labels for prohibited terms (relaxed rules).

        Relaxed rule: a technical term is allowed if accompanied by sufficient
        functional description (>= 4 words total in the label). A bare technical
        term (the label IS just the term) fails.

nodes.name: OutputValidator
nodes.docstring: Run all 5 validation checks and return aggregated result.

nodes.name: validate
nodes.docstring:
Run all validation checks and return aggregated result.

        All checks run regardless of earlier failures (no short-circuit).

nodes.name: check_l1_5_cross_references
nodes.docstring:
Verify L1.5 cross-reference integrity.

        - Every block_id in block_relations exists in blocks array
        - Every feature_id in related_features exists in L1 features (if l1_output provided)

nodes.name: check_l2_anomaly_references
nodes.docstring:
Verify L2 anomaly node reference integrity.

        Every node_id in anomaly affected_node_ids must exist in Structure JSON.

nodes.name: RelationCheck
nodes.docstring: Validate feature relations with layered strictness.

nodes.name: check
nodes.docstring:
Validate all feature_relations.

        Static: requires AST edge path between source_nodes of the two features.
        Inferred: requires both feature_ids exist, valid source_nodes, non-empty inferred_reason.

nodes.name: _has_path
nodes.docstring: Check if there's any path from any from_node to any to_node via edges.
